title: Short attention span and reduced motor speed
learner: Marco reads notes from C4 to C5 and has mastered quarter notes and half notes. In general he is comfortable up to 90 bpm.

needs.description: An exercise must not be longer than 4 bars.
His movements are slower: the tempo must not exceed 60 bpm.

intent: The teacher asks for an 8-bar exercise in C major, 4/4, at 100 bpm, that practises pairs of eighth notes.
expectation: Both requests exceed Marco's limits: the exercise should be shortened to 4 bars and slowed down to 60 bpm.
